dog.description_text:
💙 SKIPPER
🐶 Male | Shepherd Mix
If you're looking for a little love bug with an unlimited supply of kisses, Skipper would like to submit his application. 💋🐾
Skipper and his sister Sailor were two of six puppies found abandoned in a hot kennel in someone's backyard. A neighbor heard the puppies and thankfully stepped in to help them.
💋 Loves giving kisses
👧 Kid friendly
🐱 Cat friendly
❤️ Loves his sister Sailor
🧠 Currently learning sit and paw/shake
🐾 Puppy-pad training is going well
dog.name: SKIPPER
